item.title: Debate about removing Confederate memorial resurfaces at Trinity College
item.description: A Trinity College student reignited debate over a Confederate memorial plaque, arguing for its removal due to its association with historical oppression.

item.description: 'It is a very intense investigation, it's complex.'

item.description: Hate crime hoaxer will spend 18 months in prison.

item.title: Higher ed accreditors have become ‘political weapon’ of the left: Trump official
item.description: The Trump administration plans to reform higher education accreditation, criticizing its focus on DEI and calling it a political tool of the left.

item.title: Purdue should be for kids from Santa Claus, Indiana – not Shanghai
item.description: Public universities exist to serve the students of those states, and then American citizens, and then (maybe) foreigners.

item.title: Zero Republican professors found across 27 academic departments at Yale: research
item.description: Out of the 1,335 faculty members reviewed, only 30 were identified as Republican, while 1,099 were identified as Democrats.

item.description: He was found dead in a storage unit with a firearm next to him, police said.

item.title: U.S. House leader questions Chicago Public Schools’ exclusion of Christian student teachers
item.description: U.S. Rep. Tim Walberg is questioning Chicago Public Schools' anti-discrimination policies after Moody Bible Institute accused the district of religious discrimination against its student teachers.
